Extract TS features.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Time Series](../categories/time-series.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `TimeSeriesFeatures` |
| Search words | features, lag, rolling |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input time-ordered table |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Enriched** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus lag and rolling feature columns |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value_col | `value_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric column to featurize. |
| lag_values | `lag_values` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Lag values. |
| rolling_windows | `rolling_windows` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Rolling window sizes. |
| rolling_aggregations | `rolling_aggregations` | Text | `mean` |   | The run | Rolling aggregations. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
